transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I feel like my body’s kind of out of my control. At first I was pacing around my apartment all night, making all these supper-club notes, and now lately I’m the opposite—really slowed down. My sister says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?

Yes. For a while I had this nonstop energy. I couldn’t really sit still through a meal or even watch a soccer game without jumping up to make calls, sketch out menus, or start reorganizing the kitchen. It felt like I had to keep doing something.
Have you had periods where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah. Lately things I usually care about just feel… flat. Cooking, taking food photos, listening to music, pickup soccer, even volunteering—stuff that normally keeps me steady—I know I used to enjoy it, but I can’t really make myself feel interested in any of it right now.
Can you tell me if you’ve ever had a time when your mood was so high or you felt so irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self, and it lasted for several days or more?

Yes. After I got fired, I felt weirdly… unstoppable, I guess. Excited, like all my ideas were suddenly the right ones. But if anyone questioned me or told me to slow down, I’d snap at them hard, like they were trying to ruin my life. It wasn’t really like my normal self.
Can you tell me if there was ever a time when your mood was so high or you were so irritable that it was noticeably different from your usual self, and this lasted for a week or more?

Yeah, that did happen. After I got fired, I felt unusually excited and kind of unstoppable, like all my plans suddenly made perfect sense. And if anyone questioned me or told me to slow down, I’d blow up at them, like they were trying to ruin my life. It was really different from how I usually am.
Can you tell me if the time when you felt unusually excited and unstoppable lasted for at least a full week?
Yeah, it was definitely more than a week. It started after I got fired from the restaurant, and honestly it’s been going on for about four months now.
